# Factor42 Media

> Factor42 Media is a white-label ad operations and campaign fulfillment company. Agencies and broadcast/media groups sell digital campaigns to their clients; Factor42 traffics, QAs, optimizes and reports on those campaigns under the partner's brand.

- Channels: Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping), YouTube, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, Pinterest, Snapchat, programmatic (DV360, The Trade Desk, Xandr, Amazon DSP), OTT/CTV, programmatic audio, DOOH, email marketing.
- Results: 98.6% campaign delivery rate; 100+ agency and media partners; 12-minute average trafficking turnaround; Google Ads launches in under 4 hours on average.
- Who it serves: marketing agencies (white-label PPC, paid social and full ad ops) and TV/radio broadcast groups (digital fulfillment for station sellers, market-level reporting).
